changes.markdown: Quantum became a landmark in the early history of blockchain art, often discussed as an ancestor of the later NFT market. Beyond them, the light leaves room for all the arguments and possibilities that would follow.

changes.markdown: The contrast is what makes the moment memorable. Money associated with a hidden online market was passing through a public institution’s formal disposal process. The asset remained digital; the authority controlling its next transfer had changed. LORE leaves the buyer outside the frame and keeps attention on the handover itself. The Princess Bride volume quietly leads back to Silk Road’s earlier chapter, while the dated sheet brings the story forward to the sale.
